title: A Low-Regularity Semigroup Sewing Lemma via Quotient Structures
summary: We develop a low-regularity Sewing theory for the semigroup coboundary $\hatδ=δ-a$ associated with a strongly continuous semigroup $S$. Unlike the ordinary low-regularity Sewing problem, the semigroup setting has an intrinsic algebraic non-uniqueness below the threshold $1$, in the sense that solutions are canonical only modulo semigroup cocycles. Accordingly, the natural target is a quotient space rather than an increment space. We identify this quotient structure and construct the corresponding semigroup Sewing map.
